text: The procedure was remarkably straightforward. Although I am not Thai, I was treated with kindness and respect. The physician is exceptionally amiable and genuinely values his profession and responsibilities. I will certainly return here should I fall ill again.

restaurant_name: ริมเวียงคลินิก
text: Sending my support to the clinic! I've seen some negative comments, but personally, I still have confidence in the clinic and the doctor. Every time I go, the doctor is never harsh; in fact, I feel safe and better after treatment there. The prices are very affordable, the medication is effective, and the service is excellent.

restaurant_name: ริมเวียงคลินิก
text: Terrible service. When I called to inquire, they said I could come in, and I explained my symptoms a long time ago. They said yes, and I could come in. But when I arrived, they asked who I had called and who told me that, then said it wasn't possible. If they can't do something, they should at least tell me. It was a waste of time, money, and I'm very upset. You can call me back if you have a problem with this review. You'll probably know which patient I'm wasting my time on. It was raining, it was annoying, and the service was awful. They said they couldn't do it, and I was annoyed that I only got a doctor's certificate after I had clearly explained my symptoms. I've never wasted so much time in my life.
